name: inner-signal-therapy
description: InnerSignal therapy with optional authenticated private continuity in one plugin.

interface.longDescription: InnerSignal combines its therapy guidance with authenticated read-only private continuity when that MCP connection is available, so users do not need a separate handoff plugin.
